newsitem.title: USA: New York Life elects Sternberg chairman, CEO.
newsitem.headline: New York Life elects Sternberg chairman, CEO.

text.p: New York Life Insurance Co said on Wednesday its board of directors named Sy Sternberg chairman and chief executive officer, effective April 1, 1997.
Sternberg would succeed Harry Hohn, who will retire after 40 years with the company, New York Life said in a statement.
Sternberg was president and chief operating officer of New York Life and would retain the title of president, it said.

Sternberg would oversee all of the company's operations, including invidual life and annuity, group life, health and disability insurance and financial and investment services for individuals and institutions, the company said.
Sternberg joined New York Life eight years ago. Before that, he was senior executive vice president of Massachusetts Mutual Life Insurance Co.
